spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: Per time bucket: true when the signal was true at any moment in that bucket.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  max(treat_gen_warning_alarm__value) AS "Treatment plant - General warning alarm",
  max(sewage_treatment_plant_general_alarm__value) AS "Treatment plant - General alarm"
FROM marpower__340000_sewage__general
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) 
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: The latest value within the live window ($live_window), independent of the selected time range; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: seconds since the latest message.

spec.rawSql:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT * FROM marpower__340000_sewage__general
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' 
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
),
m AS (
  SELECT mqtt_json_path, max(yard_tag) AS yard_tag FROM public.marpower__io_metadata
  WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/340000-sewage' GROUP BY mqtt_json_path
)
SELECT s.signal AS "Signal",
  coalesce(m.yard_tag, s.tag) AS "Tag",
  CASE s.n
    WHEN 1 THEN CASE l.treat_gen_warning_alarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
    WHEN 2 THEN CASE l.sewage_treatment_plant_general_alarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
  END AS "State",
  to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(l.timestamp) AS "Updated"
FROM (VALUES
  (1, 'Treatment plant - General warning alarm', 'treat_gen_warning_alarm', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (2, 'Treatment plant - General alarm', 'sewage_treatment_plant_general_alarm', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'))
) AS s(n, signal, path, tag)
LEFT JOIN l ON true
LEFT JOIN m ON m.mqtt_json_path = s.path
ORDER BY s.n

spec.title: Tank levels
spec.description: The latest value within the live window ($live_window), independent of the selected time range; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: seconds since the latest message. Analog values are rounded to 2 decimals; units are in the signal name.

spec.rawSql:
WITH g0 AS (
  SELECT
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'grey-level-aft' THEN v END) AS v1,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'grey-level-aft' THEN ts END) AS t1,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'grey-level-fwd' THEN v END) AS v2,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'grey-level-fwd' THEN ts END) AS t2,
    max(CASE WHEN k LIKE 'blac%-level' THEN v END) AS v3,
    max(CASE WHEN k LIKE 'blac%-level' THEN ts END) AS t3,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'sludge-level' THEN v END) AS v4,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'sludge-level' THEN ts END) AS t4
  FROM (
    SELECT technical_name AS k, last_value(level__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS v, max(timestamp) AS ts
    FROM marpower__sewage__level_sensors
    WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' 
    GROUP BY technical_name
  ) AS x
),
m AS (
  SELECT mqtt_json_path, max(yard_tag) AS yard_tag FROM public.marpower__io_metadata
  WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/340000-sewage' GROUP BY mqtt_json_path
)
SELECT s.signal AS "Signal",
  coalesce(m.yard_tag, s.tag) AS "Tag",
  CASE s.n
    WHEN 1 THEN arrow_cast(round(g0.v1, 2), 'Utf8')
    WHEN 2 THEN arrow_cast(round(g0.v2, 2), 'Utf8')
    WHEN 3 THEN arrow_cast(round(g0.v3, 2), 'Utf8')
    WHEN 4 THEN arrow_cast(round(g0.v4, 2), 'Utf8')
  END AS "State",
  to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(CASE s.n
    WHEN 1 THEN g0.t1
    WHEN 2 THEN g0.t2
    WHEN 3 THEN g0.t3
    WHEN 4 THEN g0.t4
  END) AS "Updated"
FROM (VALUES
  (1, 'Grey water AFT tank [L]', 'grey_water_tank_aft_sb_level', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (2, 'Grey water FWD tank [L]', 'grey_water_tank_fwd_sb_level', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (3, 'Black water AFT tank [L]', 'black_grey_water_tank_aft_ps_level', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (4, 'Sludge tank [L]', 'sludge_tank_ps_level', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'))
) AS s(n, signal, path, tag)
LEFT JOIN g0 ON true
LEFT JOIN m ON m.mqtt_json_path = s.path
ORDER BY s.n

SELECT
		timestamp  			      AS time,
		UPPER(technical_name) AS name,
		level__value          AS level
	FROM marpower__sewage__level_sensors
	WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
	AND technical_name <> 'sludge-level'
	ORDER BY name, timestamp DESC

SELECT
		timestamp      AS time,
		technical_name AS name,
		level__value   AS level
	FROM marpower__sewage__level_sensors
	WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
	AND technical_name = 'sludge-level'
	ORDER BY timestamp DESC

spec.name: live_window
spec.description: How far back the Live tabs look for the latest message, independent of the time picker. The Live tables' no-data text ('No data in the last 5 minutes') repeats this value.
